parole.significato: quiet, still, be it because of pressure, fear, hypocrisy, or in order to act in secret
parole.testo: Perhaps from Latin plautus (“having flat feet, or wide ears”), via a southern dialect, like Neapolitan. The geminate -tt- may be due to influence of *plattus (“flat”) (whence Italian piatto and Neapolitan chiatto).
